mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_event_log (user_id, event_type, target_type, target_id, extra_data, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{extraData}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(extra_data, '$.keyword')) AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_event_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_type = 'SEARCH' AND extra_data IS NOT NULL GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
